text:
nora-finance: autopay on CardioPlus (acct CP-221) failed for INV-2027-013 ($23,100). Provider returned `card_not_supported`.
payments-bot: [automated] attempt=pay_f9a1, status=failed, code=card_not_supported, last4=5499, bin=549900, network=mastercard, country=US
tom-payments: bin 5499xx = Mastercard. 'card_not_supported' often means the issuer restricts the MCC for virtual cards or the token scheme. can we do one manual retry?
rachel-cs: customer already messaged CS. AP says they issued a travel/vpn vendor card. they'd prefer to send an ACH/Wire. they asked for rails + confirmation of remittance format.
leo-treasury: we can accept wire (domestic) or ACH. for domestic wire we need ABA + acct and we charge a 0.3% urgent handling fee if same-day is needed. for ACH/standard, no fee. confirm which they prefer.
tom-payments: i'll queue exactly one manual retry (no more).
payments-bot: retry queued: attempt=pay_f9a1-r1 scheduled=2027-01-08T14:05:00Z
nora-finance: retry failed. provider reason: `issuer_restricted` and message: "merchant_category_not_allowed".
tom-payments: stop auto-retries. risk of more declines and disputes. disable autopay for the invoice and ask customer to pick rails.
rachel-cs: messaging AP: "We received decline for INV-2027-013. Options: (1) domestic wire today (we charge 0.3% if urgent), (2) ACH (no fee), or (3) update to a static corporate card. If wiring, please include invoice number in reference and send bank confirmation after sending."
rachel-cs: AP replied they can wire today and requested SWIFT and beneficiary address for their bank's compliance.
leo-treasury: approved. provide canonical wire stanza and request trace after send. also log a small handling fee if they choose same-day wire.
nora-finance: wire stanza below (use exact fields to verify):
```
Beneficiary name: Redwood Inference LLC
Bank: United National Bank
Account number: 0987654321
Routing (ABA): 021000021
SWIFT/BIC: UNBKUS33
Beneficiary address: 220 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA
Reference: INV-2027-013 / CP-221
```
rachel-cs: AP sent bank confirmation (trace WIRE-20270108-CP221). scheduled to clear today. attached secure confirmation.
payments-bot: ledger note created: LE-101011, autopay_block=true, note="virtual card MCC block (5499xx)"
leo-treasury: watching for funds. when received, treasury will post and notify billing.
julia-cfo: ok to accept wire and apply 0.3% fee if they asked for same-day. route fee to "bank-fees" GL.
nora-finance: please ensure invoice shows paid_net and separate fee line WF-2027-013.
tom-payments: posted payment at 16:44Z, invoice marked PAID, applied $69.30 wire fee (0.3%). sent receipt to AP and noted re-enable autopay only after reauthorization with a stable card.
payments-bot: [automated] invoice INV-2027-013 status=paid, payment_id=wire_WIRE-20270108-CP221, posted_at=2027-01-08T16:44:12Z
rachel-cs: AP acknowledged receipt and will set billing to ACH going forward.
leo-treasury: posted reconciliation notes and closed watch.
nora-finance: added account note recommending ACH or static corporate card to avoid VPAN/MCC blocks. setting autopay disabled_until=2027-03-01 pending re-auth.
julia-cfo: thanks team. please flag any repeat failures from VPANs so we can decide policy updates.
Tom-payments: closing ticket PAY-5012 with notes. :white_check_mark:
